title: Narrated Bus Tour of Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park
overview: Take a deep dive into Bar Harbor, Acadia National Park, and Mt. Desert Island on this half-day bus tour. Since your transportation is provided, you can focus on the scenery and taking in the insightful narrative instead of driving and directions. Make three stops within the town of Bar Harbor and the National Park to witness firsthand the views and wildlife that make this island so special. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Sieur de Monts Spring, and Thunder Hole.
startDescription: 53 Main St, Bar Harbor, ME 04609, USA — Testa's Restaurant meeting point.

title: Premium Narrated Bus Tour of Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park (3.5 Hours)
overview: Known for its rocky coastlines, wealth of wildlife, and evergreen forests, Acadia National Park promises dramatic scenery—and this fully narrated driving tour makes for an easy way to discover it. Set off from Bar Harbor in a luxury Berkshire minibus, and discover highlights like Cadillac Mountain (the highest point on the East Coast), Thunder Hole (where ocean waves roar), Sieur De Mont's Spring, Jordan Pond, and much more.
startDescription: 53 Main St, Bar Harbor, ME 04609, USA.

title: Guided Ebike Tour of Acadia National Park Carriage Roads
overview: Discover Acadia National Park’s stunning Carriage Roads on a 22-mile guided e-bike tour, featuring premium Class I e-bikes for a smooth and enjoyable ride. Limited to eight riders, this top-rated tour includes stops at iconic spots like Jordan Pond House and Eagle Lake, with plenty of time for photos and relaxation. Led by expert guides, you’ll uncover the park’s rich history, hidden viewpoints, and natural wonders at a comfortable pace.
startDescription: Meet for guided e-bike departure as confirmed at booking near Acadia carriage-road access.

title: Bar Harbor Premium Tour with Cadillac Mountain and Acadia Park
overview: Discover the highlights of Bar Harbor and Acadia National Park on this small-group half-day tour. Enjoy convenient pickup from your Bar Harbor hotel, and stops at Sieur de Monts Spring, Thunder Hole, Cadillac Mountain, and more, with a local guide to provide live commentary. Includes a live lobster demonstration at Bar Harbor Lobster Pound and a tasty lobster roll.
startDescription: Hotel pickup in Bar Harbor; guests outside town meet at the Bar Harbor Town Clock.

title: Acadia Full Day Small Group Tour
overview: Explore the beauty of a national park with the help of a naturalist guide to teach you all about the flora and fauna of the area’s land and sea. You’ll enjoy a mixture of hiking on and off the beaten track, and traveling in a comfortable, air-conditioned van. You’ll be walking and learning in an intimate group where you can pick the tour leader’s brain to your heart’s content.
startDescription: 22 Albert Meadow, Bar Harbor, ME 04609, USA — Balance Rock paid parking lot area as confirmed by guide.

title: 3 Hour: The Acadia Signature, Cadillac Summit & Park Loop Road
overview: Make the most of your visit to Maine's Acadia National Park during this private, half-day guided tour with hotel pickup. Discover top highlights and hidden gems along the Park Loop Road, Otter Cliffs, Thunder Hole, Sand Beach, and more, and enjoy panoramic views from Cadillac Mountain. Tours include bottled water and private transfers in a climate-controlled vehicle.
startDescription: Hotel pickup from downtown Bar Harbor lodging, or Hulls Cove Visitor Center for guests outside downtown.

overview: Explore the highlights of Maine's Acadia National Park during this private, half-day guided tour. Get personalized recommendations and information from your tour guide. Cover the Park Loop Road, with panoramic views from Cadillac Mountain—no climbing necessary. Tours include private transfers in a climate-controlled vehicle.

overview: Cadillac Summit is amazing any time of day, but there’s something enchanting about sunrise and sunset. Your guide will contact you via email or phone to solidify times and itinerary, as this tour is highly customizable.
